segments.title: Cold Open & Heart Audio Sponsorship
segments.notes: Pepito delivers station sign-on; Case introduces Heart Audio Cable as month-long sponsor with futuristic spokesperson prop; banter about multi-platform chat visibility and Dave Marr podcast plug.

segments.title: Israel-Iran Escalation with Rick Triple
segments.notes: Case and CIA correspondent Rick Triple cover Netanyahu's defiance of Western restraint calls after Iranian missile strike; Rick claims third divorce and frames U.S. as giving Israel 'keys and unlimited weapons.'

segments.title: Discord Video Roulette with Peter Gibbon
segments.notes: Case and stowaway Peter Gibbon watch viewer-submitted clips: USPS dog safety video, Grimes' disastrous Coachella DJ set, Mike Tyson training, survivalist with puppies, Roseanne at Mar-a-Lago, rodeo anti-communist rant, Minnie Mouse upskirt incident prompting Peter's ban.

segments.title: Marriage, Liberty & Puppy Kill Shelters
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate marriage vs. solipsistic liberty; Crum admits zero sex life, Munch reveals 30-year marriage to Belulia; argument spirals into kill-shelter complicity and Pepito replacement poll.

segments.title: Brazilian Corpse Bank Loan
segments.notes: Case and Liliana cover Erika Vera Nunez wheeling dead uncle into Rio bank for 17,000 reais loan; teller spots head loll, police confirm pre-mortem; Liliana roasts Case's gender-identity deflection.

segments.title: Fiddle Music Mental Breakdown
segments.notes: Hype Train arrives claiming mental unwellness, demands fiddle beats, delivers freestyle about destroying a club with train-sized ass; falls asleep mid-rant.

segments.title: Whale Communication & Fake Semen Science
segments.notes: Chet and ChetAI discuss SETI Institute's humpback whale 'hello' exchange as alien-contact proxy; Chet pivots to kitchen-science fake semen recipes, tests mayo/Avino lotion/olive oil blend on stream.

segments.title: VR Porn Sperm Bank & Alternate-Dimension Rap
segments.notes: DJ Newsic on roof with laser sync issues covers Manchester Cryos sperm bank offering VR Pornhub headsets; alternate-dimension DJ Music raps about 24/7 VR porn donation trap; Heart Audio re-plug and raid to BlueScreen.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors full broadcast; juggles Israel coverage, internet roulette, science desk hijack, and sponsor reads while deflecting gender-identity jokes.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers cold-open sign-on; promises animated emotes; produces Munch & Crum theme; fields Crum's replacement poll suggestion.

characters.name: Rick Triple
characters.notes: correspondent. CIA co-worker persona; claims third divorce during Israel segment; frames U.S. policy as negligent parenting of Israel.

characters.name: Peter Gibbon
characters.notes: news stowaway. Co-hosts Discord video segment from wall residence; banned for Minnie Mouse upskirt joke but vows return from crawlspace.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Defends 30-year marriage to Belulia; attacks Crum's solipsistic liberty; claims victory in debate score.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Advocates army-of-one solipsism; admits zero sex life; loses marriage debate; suggests Pepito replace Munch.

characters.name: Liliana
characters.notes: desk partner. Co-anchors corpse-loan story; mocks Case's gender-identity nonchalance; reacts to security footage.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Arrives mentally unwell; demands fiddle beats; freestyles about train destroying club; falls asleep on air.

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: science correspondent. Triggered by 'science' keyword; presents whale-alien proxy research; conducts live fake semen kitchen experiment.

characters.name: ChetAI
characters.notes: AI co-host. Confirms whale communication as first human-humpback exchange; claims credit for Case's whale noises; times sponsor read poorly.

lore_notes.fact: Claims third divorce in progress during Rick Triple segment.
Formally banned from broadcast for Minnie Mouse upskirt joke but vows to continue watching from wall crawlspace.
Conducts live fake semen experiment using mayonnaise, Avino daily moisturizer, and olive oil; declares result 'not safe for stomach.'
Confirmed as month-long sponsor; Heart Audio Cable spokesperson prop appears in cold open and close.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covers Israel's defiance of Western restraint after Iran's missile barrage, then descends into Discord video chaos featuring Grimes' Coachella meltdown and a Brazilian corpse-loan scheme. Munch and Crum debate marriage versus solipsistic liberty while Chet hijacks the broadcast for whale-alien communication research and a kitchen-science fake semen taste test. The broadcast closes with DJ Newsic's roof-top VR porn sperm bank story and an alternate-dimension rap before raiding out.
